# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- NU1202: Package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 11.0.0 is not compatible with net10.0
- TargetFramework net10.0 requires compatible EF Core versions
- For the TaskApi workspace, ignore the legacy root application; limit changes and build validation to the newer layered projects under src/; do not modify or validate the root TaskApi.csproj implementation.
